patterns: Most-repeated fact: Tebhaga demand = cut landlord's share from one-half to one-third (bargadars keep two-thirds); led by Kisan Sabha.
APPSC asks Telangana armed struggle via people and incidents: Doddi Komaraiah killed 4 July 1946 for defending Chakali Ailamma's land; Andhra Mahasabha; Veera Telangana author.
Location/leader one-liners recur: Moplah = Malabar; Eka = Hardoi/Barabanki, Madari Pasi; UP Kisan Sabha 1918 (Nehru not a founder).
UPSC uses contrast items (Eka vs Bardoli): Bardoli against land-revenue enhancement, Eka violent and outside Congress.
App adds much Andhra Ranga/anti-zamindari detail (Nidubrolu, Kankipadu, Munagala) - aligned with APPSC tilt; statements are sound.
